allegation_summary: HELOC executed 07/21/2022; Lendage originator; MERS nominee; $149,650.00 limit; 10.750%
what_source_shows: The court's background footnote states a July 2022 Lendage origination of $149,650.00
notes: The rate and the 120-month term are not corroborated by any source in the manifest; they come from loan documents nobody has read.

allegation_summary: Only $51,409.50 appeared in Plaintiff's BofA account on 08/05/2022 at 8:20 AM (Ex. 7)
what_source_shows: NO SOURCE IN THE MANIFEST. The screenshot is described as Ex. 7 but is not among the sources reviewed.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: Total as to the document. The allegation is pleaded on personal knowledge plus a contemporaneous screenshot.
basis_if_unsupported: Christopher J. Carrelha has personal knowledge of what appeared in his own account, and the screenshot is said to exist as Ex. 7. BASIS ADEQUATE for pleading; NOT adequate for proof.
notes: The allegation is properly framed - personal knowledge of one's own bank account is exactly what that basis is for. What it does NOT establish is where the other ~$98,000 went, and the pleading should not be read as asserting it went nowhere.

allegation_summary: Recorded Assignment recites MEB as 'a[n] CORPORATION organized under the laws of NEW YORK'
what_source_shows: SRC-021 quotes the recital. THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF WAS NOT READ.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: One level of remove: the source is the pleading's quotation of an exhibit, not the exhibit.
basis_if_unsupported: The assignment is a recorded public record at Deed Book 11187, Page 717, obtainable today.
notes: GAP-020. Verify the quotation against the instrument before it appears in a brief.

allegation_summary: MERS ServicerID identifies the Investor as FREED Mortgage Trust 2022-HE1, not MEB
what_source_shows: SRC-021 describes a lookup retrieved 2026-03-24 as Ex. 6. THE LOOKUP ITSELF WAS NOT SEEN.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: One level of remove, and the field is 'Investor' rather than 'owner' - a different question.
basis_if_unsupported: Ex. 6 is said to exist and the lookup is publicly re-runnable today.
notes: Strong as a records-inconsistency point; weak if pleaded as proof that FREED owns the loan. TRF-004.

allegation_summary: Plaintiffs' HELOC falls within the FREED origination-and-date profile
what_source_shows: The DBRS release establishes a Lendage-originated pool with a 2022-09-30 cut-off. It identifies no individual loan.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: Large. Fitting a profile is not membership, and the pleading says 'on information and belief', which is the right framing.
basis_if_unsupported: The basis for the belief IS stated in the paragraph itself (originator and date match a public presale report). Membership is peculiarly within Defendants' knowledge.
notes: Correctly pleaded. It would become a Rule 11 problem only if restated as an assertion of fact that this loan IS in the FREED trust.

allegation_summary: Every ledger row after 07/07/2024 bears a frozen Due Date of 01/01/24 and principal never moves
what_source_shows: Confirmed on every row: Due Date 01/01/24 throughout, principal $140,288.02 unchanged 12/21/23 to 03/10/26
notes: Fully corroborated by the defendant's own document. One of the pleading's best-supported paragraphs.

allegation_summary: A Late Charge Balance of $1,145.62 appears at the 08/05/2022 origination row with no assessing entry
what_source_shows: Confirmed. The balance is present on the origination row and no Late Charge Assess line precedes it.
notes: Accurate as written. The pleading is careful to say it 'lacks a documented basis on the face of the Ledger' rather than asserting it was wrongly charged - that restraint is correct and should be preserved. TXN-002.

allegation_summary: Four TPP payments of $1,899.56 between 04/29/2025 and 06/25/2025; each reversed with NSF; none returned by the depositary institution
what_source_shows: The ledger shows four tenders and THREE reversals. The 05/17/2025 tender was NEVER reversed and remains the Ending Unapplied Balance.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: MATERIAL DISCREPANCY: the pleading says EACH of the four was reversed. The ledger shows three of four. The pleading understates its own best fact.
basis_if_unsupported: Plaintiffs have personal knowledge of their own bank records; those records are NOT in the manifest.
notes: TWO PROBLEMS. (1) 'each of those payments was... reversed' is contradicted by the defendant's own ledger as to the 05/17/25 tender - and the unreversed one is the STRONGER fact. Correct it and the paragraph improves. (2) The date range '04/29/2025' does not match the ledger's first tender date of 05/02/2025; tender and posting dates differ, but the pleading should say which it means. DISP-003.

allegation_summary: A $10,000 principal-reduction payment on or about 09/15/2023 was reversed by a 'Principal Adjustment' entry
what_source_shows: Confirmed: +$10,000.00 on 09/15/23, -$10,000.00 on 09/26/23, principal restored exactly.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: Small but real: the ledger calls the reversing entry 'Principal Only Payment', not 'Principal Adjustment'.
notes: Quote the ledger's own words. A defendant that can say 'no such entry as a Principal Adjustment appears' gets a free point. DISP-004.

allegation_summary: Plaintiffs tendered an $855 payment in 2023 that SHELLPOINT rejected despite sufficient funds
what_source_shows: The ledger shows $855.00 into suspense 09/26/23 and out 10/11/23, BOTH rows marked money type 'PriorServicer'. It shows no rejection and no reason.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: TWO GAPS: (1) the ledger does not show a rejection, only movement through suspense; (2) both rows predate Shellpoint's 07/07/2024 boarding by ten months and are marked PriorServicer.
basis_if_unsupported: Plaintiffs have personal knowledge of the tender and of funds on deposit; the bank record is not in the manifest.
notes: MISATTRIBUTED DEFENDANT. This conduct, if anyone's, is SLS's. Asserting it against Shellpoint is contradicted by the defendant's own ledger and is curable by redraft. DISP-005.

allegation_summary: At least fifteen foreclosure-related fee disbursements between 07/19/2024 and 01/13/2026 exceeding $3,500
what_source_shows: Confirmed and exceeded: 20 entries totalling $5,394.13 in that window; 27 entries totalling $8,408.74 across the full ledger.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: None - the pleading understates the record.
notes: Well pleaded and conservative. The actual figures are stronger. DISP-006.

allegation_summary: Ten QWR/NOE/RFI inquiries were transmitted; at least thirteen boilerplate acknowledgments were received
what_source_shows: NO NOE, RFI, QWR OR ACKNOWLEDGMENT LETTER IS IN THE MANIFEST.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: Total. Ten inquiries and thirteen responses are pleaded; zero are in the record reviewed.
basis_if_unsupported: Plaintiffs have personal knowledge of what they sent and received; the documents are said to be in their possession.
notes: THE HIGHEST RULE 11 EXPOSURE IN THE PLEADING, and also the element the RESPA counts stand or fall on. Not because the allegation is likely false - it is likely true - but because a specific count ('ten', 'at least thirteen') invites a demand to produce them, and SRC-012 shows the designated address is a PO Box while the documented channel is the CFPB portal. GAP-003.

allegation_summary: SLS's CFPB response confirmed reinstatement funds received 09/13/2023 bringing the account current, while reporting 03/2023-08/2023 as 30+ days past due
what_source_shows: The ledger corroborates the reinstatement: $19,588.88 in on 09/13/23, distributed 09/14/23 across due dates 02/2023 through 10/2023.
gap_between_allegation_and_source: The SLS CFPB response ITSELF is not in the manifest - only the ledger corroboration of what it is said to have confirmed.
basis_if_unsupported: The CFPB response is a document Plaintiffs received and can produce.
notes: STRUCTURALLY THE STRONGEST FCRA FACT AVAILABLE: a servicer's own record showing months satisfied, against furnished data reporting those same months delinquent. But NO CREDIT REPORT IS IN THE MANIFEST, so the furnishing half is undocumented. DISP-002, GAP-004.
